evidence.quote: Keep fees separate and ensure any amount the court does not award goes to the class rather than Brightline.
We propose a $35 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members. Brightline would separately pay up to $3.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses

summary: Class counsel raised fees in its opening proposal, before the class fund was settled. The parties negotiated both amounts, but the transcript does not show a fee-for-relief tradeoff or a misleading declaration.
